name: Whistleblower Protection
summary: Employees can raise safety concerns with the board, regulators and the public, with no retaliation and no contracts that silence them.
description: Employees often see risks first. If contracts or fear of retaliation keep them quiet, the public and regulators learn about risks only after harm occurs.

criteria.label: No Silencing Contracts
criteria.description: No non-disparagement or confidentiality terms that block safety concerns, and old terms are released.

criteria.label: Anonymous Channel
criteria.description: An anonymous channel to the board or to an independent party.

criteria.label: Outside Reporting
criteria.description: Employees may report to regulators and, when other channels fail, to the public.

criteria.label: No Retaliation
criteria.description: A published policy prohibits retaliation for raising safety concerns.

orgs.summary: OpenAI's published policy bans retaliation, allows reports to regulators, and offers an anonymous line plus direct reports to the board's safety committee.

events.title: Releases former employees from non-disparagement obligations
events.summary: After reports on exit agreements, OpenAI said it will remove non-disparagement clauses from standard departure papers and release former employees from them, unless the clause was mutual.

quote.text: We'll remove nondisparagement clauses from our standard departure paperwork, and we'll release former employees from existing nondisparagement obligations unless the nondisparagement provision was mutual.

sources.title: OpenAI sends internal memo releasing former employees from controversial exit agreements

events.title: Whistleblowers allege agreements blocked reports to regulators
events.summary: Whistleblowers told the SEC that past OpenAI agreements required consent before disclosures to regulators and waived whistleblower awards. OpenAI said its whistleblower policy protects protected disclosures.

quote.text: Our whistleblower policy protects employees’ rights to make protected disclosures.

sources.title: OpenAI illegally barred staff from airing safety risks, whistleblowers say
OpenAI NDAs violate whistleblower laws, attorneys tell SEC

events.title: Publishes Raising Concerns Policy with anonymous line
events.summary: OpenAI published its Raising Concerns Policy. It bans retaliation for concerns raised in good faith, offers an anonymous Integrity Line, and says employees may contact agencies such as the SEC.

quote.text: OpenAI does not tolerate harassment or retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith, no matter who is involved and even if the concern later turns out to be unsubstantiated.

sources.title: OpenAI Expands Their Raising Concerns Policy - AIWI’s Preliminary Assessment & Evaluation of OpenAI's 2024 Policy

events.title: California law adds protections for covered employees
events.summary: California SB 53 takes effect. Large frontier developers must not block or punish disclosures of catastrophic risk to authorities, and must give covered employees an anonymous internal channel.

quote.text: A large frontier developer shall provide a reasonable internal process through which a covered employee may anonymously disclose information to the large frontier developer

sources.title: SB-53 Artificial intelligence models: large developers.

events.title: Publishes revised and longer Raising Concerns Policy
events.summary: OpenAI published a revised Raising Concerns Policy. It bans retaliation, keeps the anonymous Integrity Line, and names agencies for reports. Trade secret disclosure stays prohibited, subject to protected disclosures.

quote.text: Our policy also makes clear that employees have the right to make reports or disclosures to government agencies, including the U.S. National Labor Relations Board, the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, and the California Attorney General’s Office.

sources.title: OpenAI Expands Their Raising Concerns Policy - AIWI’s Preliminary Assessment & Evaluation of OpenAI's 2024 Policy

events.title: Employees can report directly to board safety committee
events.summary: The updated policy lets employees report AI safety concerns directly to the board's Safety and Security Committee. A third party hosts the anonymous Integrity Line. Public disclosure is protected only in limited cases.

quote.text: At any time, you can escalate your concern through the Integrity Line, or directly to the SSC.

no-silencing-contracts.commitment: Released former staff from non-disparagement terms.
no-silencing-contracts.missing: Mutual terms excepted; trade secret limits remain, subject to protected disclosures.

anonymous-channel.commitment: EQS-hosted public anonymous Integrity Line; direct reports to the board's Safety and Security Committee.

outside-reporting.commitment: Staff may report to agencies like the SEC and California AG without notice.
outside-reporting.missing: Public disclosure is protected only in limited cases.

no-retaliation.commitment: Public Raising Concerns Policy bans retaliation for good-faith concerns, including outside reports.

orgs.summary: Anthropic's published policy bans retaliation, allows reports to regulators, and offers an anonymous third-party hotline. Non-disparagement terms do not cover safety concerns.

events.title: Plans anonymous noncompliance reporting before reaching ASL-3
events.summary: Responsible Scaling Policy 1.0 says the company will create a noncompliance reporting policy that allows anonymous feedback, as part of reaching ASL-3.

quote.text: The policy should allow for anonymous feedback, with an appropriate reporting chain.

events.title: Policy adds anonymous reporting and anti-retaliation terms
events.summary: Responsible Scaling Policy 2.0 commits to anonymous noncompliance reports to the Responsible Scaling Officer, protection from retaliation, and no non-disparagement terms that impede public safety concerns.

quote.text: We will not impose contractual non-disparagement obligations on employees, candidates, or former employees in a way that could impede or discourage them from publicly raising safety concerns about Anthropic.

events.title: Publishes noncompliance reporting and anti-retaliation policy
events.summary: Anthropic published its RSP Noncompliance and Anti-Retaliation Policy. Staff can report anonymously through a NAVEX hotline to the Responsible Scaling Officer. It covers RSP noncompliance only.

sources.title: Anthropic Publishes Their (Partial) Whistleblowing Policy – First Thoughts And Context

events.title: Updated policy adds channels and government reporting rights
events.summary: The February 2026 update expands reporting channels. It offers an anonymous hotline on an independent third-party platform, bans retaliation, and says no agreement stops reports of legal violations to government authorities.

quote.text: Anthropic prohibits retaliation against those who, in good faith, engage in a protected activity.

sources.title: RSP Noncompliance Reporting and Anti-Retaliation Policy
AI Safety Index Summer 2026: Whistleblowing Policy Transparency

no-silencing-contracts.commitment: Policy bars such terms for public safety concerns; past terms not enforced for them.
no-silencing-contracts.missing: No general release of past terms found.

anonymous-channel.commitment: Independent third-party hotline takes anonymous reports; the board gets quarterly updates.
anonymous-channel.missing: Reports go to the Responsible Scaling Officer, not the board.

outside-reporting.commitment: No agreement stops reports of legal violations to government authorities.
outside-reporting.missing: No protected route to the public found.

no-retaliation.commitment: Public RSP Noncompliance Reporting and Anti-Retaliation Policy covers good-faith protected activity.

orgs.summary: Meta's framework describes an anonymous internal reporting protocol, still in development, with protection from retaliation.

events.title: Framework adds anonymous reporting and retaliation protection
events.summary: Framework version 2 says Meta is developing a protocol for anonymous internal reports of framework noncompliance and catastrophic risk, with protection from retaliation.

quote.text: all employees who in good faith report non-compliance or decline to engage in unlawful conduct will be explicitly protected from adverse employment action and retaliation.

no-silencing-contracts.missing: No public statement found on non-disparagement or confidentiality terms.

anonymous-channel.commitment: Planned protocol will allow anonymous internal reports to internal leaders.
anonymous-channel.missing: Still in development; no route to the board or an independent party.

outside-reporting.missing: No statement found on reports to regulators or the public.

no-retaliation.commitment: Framework says good-faith noncompliance reporters will be protected.
no-retaliation.missing: The protocol is still in development.

orgs.summary: California law requires xAI to protect covered employees. Its June 2026 framework removed its own whistleblower terms.

events.title: Draft framework allows anonymous noncompliance reports
events.summary: The draft Risk Management Framework says employees can anonymously report noncompliance with protection from retaliation, and can raise imminent public safety threats with government agencies.

quote.text: Internally, we will allow xAI employees to anonymously report concerns about noncompliance, with protections from retaliation.

events.title: Framework update removes whistleblower and anonymous reporting terms
events.summary: The June 2026 framework no longer includes the anonymous reporting, retaliation and whistleblower terms, or references to California's law. The law still applies to large frontier developers.

no-silencing-contracts.commitment: California law bars contracts that stop covered employees' catastrophic-risk reports to authorities.
no-silencing-contracts.missing: xAI states no terms of its own.

anonymous-channel.commitment: Law requires an anonymous internal process for covered employees.
anonymous-channel.missing: June 2026 framework removed xAI's own anonymous reporting terms.

outside-reporting.commitment: Law protects covered employees who report catastrophic risk to authorities.
outside-reporting.missing: No protected route to the public found.

no-retaliation.commitment: Law bars retaliation for covered disclosures.

orgs.summary: Microsoft's framework says employees can report concerns through internal channels with an anonymous option, and are protected from retaliation.

events.title: Framework offers anonymous reporting with retaliation protection
events.summary: The Frontier Governance Framework says employees can report concerns about the framework and AI governance through existing channels, with protection from retaliation and an anonymous option.

quote.text: Microsoft employees have the ability to report concerns relating to this framework and its implementation, as well as AI governance at Microsoft more broadly, using our existing concern reporting channels, with protection from retaliation and the option for anonymity.

no-silencing-contracts.missing: No public statement found on non-disparagement or confidentiality terms.

anonymous-channel.commitment: Existing internal channels offer an anonymous option.
anonymous-channel.missing: No named channel to the board or an independent party.

outside-reporting.missing: No statement found on reports to regulators or the public.

no-retaliation.commitment: Public framework protects staff who raise AI governance concerns from retaliation.
